response.sql: WITH matched_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) as count FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), avg_all AS (SELECT AVG(count) as avg_count FROM matched_counts), above_avg AS (SELECT mc.count, mc.count - aa.avg_count as excess FROM matched_counts mc CROSS JOIN avg_all aa WHERE mc.count > aa.avg_count) SELECT AVG(count) as average_count, AVG(excess) as average_excess FROM above_avg
